title: AI inventory snapshot
description: Versioned export of the AI inventory with provider, model version, prompt and tool versions, data classes, tenant scope, authority ceiling and owner, plus reconciliation diff against the prior release.

title: Tool broker denial records for unregistered agents
description: Log of tool requests refused because the agent identity is not in the capability manifest.
retention: Per SOC 2 evidence retention (to be set with auditor per SOC2-023)

title: Approved AI policy record
description: AI policy document with version, approver, approval date, next review date and acknowledgment records from personnel and agent operators.
format: Markdown in source control with approval record

title: AI control crosswalk
description: Generated mapping from Echelon AI controls to external AI frameworks with links to the evidence each control emits.

title: AI risk and impact assessment record
description: Completed assessment per AI use and per material change: affected parties, authority tier, risks, mitigations, regulatory classification, approver and gate result.

title: Subgroup error report
description: Recall and false-alert rates of automated matching or scoring by relevant subgroup on the versioned test suite, at each change and quarterly.

title: AI provider due diligence file
description: Per provider: assurance report review, CUEC mapping, model documentation reviewed, deprecation and change terms, pinned model versions, evaluation results before version adoption.

title: AI provider data terms register
description: Per provider and offering: training prohibition, prompt and output retention, abuse monitoring review terms, zero-retention status, processing regions, contract reference and review date.

title: AI law applicability determinations
description: Register rows for each AI law with role, classification, facts, counsel reviewer and date, and re-evaluation triggers.

title: Model documentation package
description: Per model-like component: purpose, design, data, assumptions, limitations, evaluation results, monitoring metrics and change log; with change notices sent to customers.

title: AI use statement and tenant AI configuration
description: Published AI use statement version history and per-tenant record of AI features enabled or disabled, with change events.
